data.title: William Lancaster gave Lulu and Georgia 1 star. Check out the full review...
data.content:
* * *

![Image 1: Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

Aug 20, 2023

## [I spent $3,255.00+$584.70 in shipping…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/64e2280f8939eed74a3c0b31)
I spent $3,255.00+$584.70 in shipping it was a total of 8 items that I purchased online on August 17, 2023. I haven’t received one of my Study of Form wall art paintings, which cost me $798.00 and I bought two of them only to receive one. I reached out to Lulu and Georgia and they keep trying to tell me that I received the items after I showed the packing slip which shows one item was shipped off the painting…. I will never purchase anything from Lulu and Georgia company again, it was and is the worst experience I have had with online shopping.

August 8, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Aug 31, 2023

Hi William, we’re so sorry about the delays you experienced with the made to order art pieces that you purchased from us. We can see that our Customer Experience team reached out to you this week with an updated ship date, along with tracking information. We are also available on Live Chat Monday-Friday and we offer scheduled phone call backs, but please let us know if there’s anything else we can help with in the meantime.
